Text.Text: The Silverwood packs are ranging too close to the city roads. Eight fewer hunters will give the freight crews room to move.
Keep to the Silverwood Expanse. I need eight dire wolves removed, not a hunt through the farmsteads.
Keep to the Silverwood Expanse. I need eight dire wolves removed, not a hunt through the farmsteads.
The patrol tally confirms eight dire wolves down. Give me your field report and I’ll close the Silverwood posting.
Good. The road crews can stop watching every snowbank for teeth. Take the posted hazard pay.
The Silverwood road remains open because of your work.
The pale ones aren't scavengers. They're pushing lesser packs toward our walls. Bring down six frost dire wolves before that pressure breaks the patrol line.
Watch for pale coats against the snow. Six frost dire wolves, then report directly to me.
Watch for pale coats against the snow. Six frost dire wolves, then report directly to me.
Six frost-wolf losses are showing in the outer patrol reports. Confirm the engagement and we’ll settle the hazard pay.
That should scatter the rest and take pressure off the outer patrols. You've earned the cold-weather premium.
The frost pack has not re-formed since your strike.
One alpha is holding the scattered packs together. Kill it and the survivors should remember that the city isn't their hunting ground.
Follow the heavier tracks and listen before you crest a ridge. The alpha won't be alone, even if it's the only target that matters.
Follow the heavier tracks and listen before you crest a ridge. The alpha won't be alone, even if it's the only target that matters.
The lesser packs are already scattering. Tell me the alpha is dead and I’ll strike the hunt from the board.
Then the approaches will quiet down. Strength answered cleanly is a language every pack understands.
The packs still avoid the approach where you brought down their alpha.
Neo-Crusader scouts are ranging through the Winter Marches and marking gaps in our patrols. Remove seven before their maps become an invasion route.
Don't chase decoys into the open. Seven confirmed scouts will force their commanders to move without fresh terrain data.
Don't chase decoys into the open. Seven confirmed scouts will force their commanders to move without fresh terrain data.
Enemy reconnaissance traffic just went quiet. Give me your scout count.
Excellent. An army without eyes wastes time, fuel, and soldiers. We can use all three.
The Neo-Crusaders still haven't replaced the scouts you removed.
Their hunters have stopped chasing soldiers. They're taking couriers and anyone who knows the side trails through the Veylan Groves. End six of those hunts.
Use the trees for cover, but assume they've trapped the obvious paths. Six hunters. No trophies required.
Use the trees for cover, but assume they've trapped the obvious paths. Six hunters. No trophies required.
Our couriers reached the groves without being shadowed. Report what happened to the hunters.
Our couriers can move again. More importantly, the enemy now knows the groves don't belong to them.
Courier traffic through the Veylan Groves has returned to schedule.
Vanguard teams are striking our outer positions to measure response time. Put down eight and make every timing figure they collected obsolete.
Expect disciplined pairs and overlapping fire. Eight vanguards removed will make the next probe too expensive to justify.
Expect disciplined pairs and overlapping fire. Eight vanguards removed will make the next probe too expensive to justify.
The latest vanguard probe broke formation early. I’m ready for your casualty report.
Then their officers have a choice: slow down or spend troops they can't replace. Either answer helps us.
The enemy vanguard has kept its distance since your counterattack.
Heavy troopers are hauling crew-served weapons onto the heights. Five emplacements are active. Silence the operators before those lanes become kill zones.
Approach from broken ground and keep moving once they range you. Five heavy troopers are enough to collapse the firing plan.
Approach from broken ground and keep moving once they range you. Five heavy troopers are enough to collapse the firing plan.
Those firing lanes have gone silent. Confirm the five heavy positions are finished.
Our transports can use those routes again. The logistics office authorized a proper demolition bonus for this one.
No replacement heavy positions have appeared on the heights.
Their field medics keep damaged assault cells moving when they should be retreating. Remove five, and every wound starts costing the Neo-Crusaders ground.
Medics stay behind the armored line until someone falls. Don't let the formation draw you away from the five targets.
Medics stay behind the armored line until someone falls. Don't let the formation draw you away from the five targets.
Neo-Crusader assault cells are withdrawing their wounded. Give me the medic count.
We've already seen wounded units withdrawing instead of regrouping. Cold arithmetic, but it shortens the battle.
Enemy casualty teams remain thin after the medics you removed.
Three captains are coordinating the pressure on our outer districts. Remove all three and their separate assault cells will start competing instead of cooperating.
Captains will be surrounded by their best troops. Confirm three eliminations; anything less leaves their command net intact.
Captains will be surrounded by their best troops. Confirm three eliminations; anything less leaves their command net intact.
Their command channels are talking over one another. Confirm all three captains are down.
Their channels are already contradicting each other. You've bought every district commander breathing room.
Neo-Crusader field command remains fractured after your strike.

Four Thyrsian warriors who once served the Revanite Order have entered the fight. They're not screening troops or holding ground; they're measuring our best defenders. Defeat them and give the exiles an answer worth carrying home.
They'll punish impatience. Control the distance, refuse their rhythm, and don't mistake ceremony for restraint.
They'll punish impatience. Control the distance, refuse their rhythm, and don't mistake ceremony for restraint.
The Thyrsian exiles have pulled back to reassess. Tell me exactly how their challenge ended.
Then let that be the report they take from our world. You stood where they expected weakness and gave them none.
The Thyrsian exiles remember the answer you gave them on Eshan.
